title: Interstellar
description: A sci-fi space adventure where a team of astronauts travels through a wormhole near Saturn in search of a new habitable planet to save humanity from a dying Earth.

title: Gravity
description: Two astronauts are stranded in deep space after the mid-orbit destruction of their space shuttle, fighting for survival as they attempt to return to Earth.

title: The Martian
description: During a manned mission to Mars, an astronaut is presumed dead after a fierce storm and left behind. He must use his scientific ingenuity and humor to survive alone on the hostile planet.

title: The Matrix
description: A computer hacker learns from mysterious rebels about the true nature of his reality as a simulated world created by sentient machines, and his role in the war against its controllers.

title: Inception
description: A skilled thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a CEO.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime in Gotham City, facing off against the Joker, a criminal mastermind who plunges the city into anarchy and chaos.

title: John Wick
description: An ex-hitman comes out of retirement to track down the gangsters that killed his dog and took everything from him in a relentless, high-octane action thriller.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search for her homeland with the aid of a group of female prisoners and a drifter named Max.

title: Avengers: Endgame
description: After the devastating events of Infinity War, the remaining Avengers assemble once more in a final stand to reverse Thanos's actions and restore balance to the universe.

title: Gladiator
description: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery as an arena gladiator.

title: Titanic
description: A seventeen-year-old aristocrat falls in love with a kind but poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated R.M.S. Titanic in this tragic and emotional romantic drama.

title: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge
description: Two young non-resident Indians fall in love during a vacation across Europe, and the boy must travel to India to win over the girl's strict, traditional family.

title: La La Land
description: While navigating their careers in Los Angeles, a pianist and an actress fall in love while attempting to reconcile their artistic aspirations for the future.

title: The Notebook
description: A poor yet passionate young man falls in love with a rich young woman, giving her a sense of freedom, but they are soon separated because of their social differences.

title: Forrest Gump
description: The presidencies of Kennedy and Johnson, the Vietnam War, and other historical events unfold from the perspective of an Alabama man with a kind heart and an IQ of 75.

title: Toy Story
description: A cowboy doll is profoundly threatened and jealous when a new spaceman action figure supplants him as top toy in a boy's bedroom in this funny animated comedy.

title: Finding Nemo
description: After his son is captured in the Great Barrier Reef and taken to Sydney, a timid clownfish sets out on a humorous and heartwarming journey across the ocean to bring him home.

title: 3 Idiots
description: Two friends embark on a quest for a lost buddy, recalling their college days and their inspirational friend who taught them to think differently about life and education.

title: The Hangover
description: Three buddies wake up from a bachelor party in Las Vegas, with no memory of the previous night and the bachelor missing, forcing them to retrace their wild steps.

title: Superbad
description: Two co-dependent high school seniors are forced to deal with separation anxiety after their plan to stage a booze-soaked party goes hilariously awry.

title: Taare Zameen Par
description: An eight-year-old boy is thought to be a lazy trouble-maker until a new compassionate art teacher discovers that he actually suffers from dyslexia and helps him shine.

title: The Pursuit of Happyness
description: A struggling salesman takes custody of his young son as he's poised to begin a life-changing professional career, battling homelessness and hardship with determination.

title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
description: An Indian man with a magnanimous heart takes a young mute Pakistani girl back to her homeland to reunite her with her family against all odds.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: Two imprisoned men bond over a number of years, finding solace and eventual redemption through acts of common decency inside a harsh maximum-security prison.

title: Dangal
description: Former wrestler Mahavir Singh Phogat and his two feisty daughters struggle towards glory at the Commonwealth Games in the face of societal oppression.

title: Fight Club
description: An insomniac office worker and a devil-may-care soap maker form an underground fight club that evolves into something much more sinister and chaotic.

title: The Godfather
description: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty in postwar New York City transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant youngest son.

title: Joker
description: In Gotham City, mentally troubled comedian Arthur Fleck is disregarded and mistreated by society. He then embarks on a downward spiral of revolution and bloody crime.

title: Se7en
description: Two detectives, a rookie and a veteran, hunt a serial killer who uses the seven deadly sins as his motives in a dark, gritty psychological thriller.

title: Shutter Island
description: In 1954, a U.S. Marshal investigates the disappearance of a murderer who escaped from a hospital for the criminally insane on a remote, stormy island.
